title: Faith isn’t crushed — it’s uncovered in the shaping
paragraphs: Faith isn’t crushed — it’s uncovered in the shaping
Every spin of the wheel reveals what’s already in the clay.

Isaiah 64:8 (ESV)
“But now, O Lord, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are our potter; we are all the work of Your hand.”
The potter metaphor reveals, not tests — the divine shaping process uncovers what was always within His creation.
